# @kayjs/auth Reference

> Zero-dependency Bun-native authentication: Argon2id passwords, hashed DB sessions, email verification, magic links, OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, route guards, and RGPD helpers.

## Imports

- `@kayjs/auth`: `createAuth`, `memoryAuthStore`, `normalizeEmail`, `toPublicUser`, `safeRedirect` (re-exported from `@kayjs/kay/server`), `createRateLimiter` (deprecated: `rateLimit` on `api.route()` and `action()`, or `api.rateLimiter()`), `github`, `discord`, `google`, `oauthProvider`; types `Auth`, `AuthOptions`, `GuardOptions`, `AuthStore`, `AuthUser`, `PublicUser`, `AuthSession`, `OAuthAccount`, `TokenKind`, `VerificationToken`, `UserExport`, `AuthMailPayload`, `AuthMailer`, `CreateUserInput`, `OAuthProvider`, `OAuthPresetConfig`, `OAuthProfile`, `RateLimiter`, `RateLimitOptions`.
- `@kayjs/auth/sqlite`: `sqliteAuthStore(dbOrPath?: string | Database)` (returns `AuthStore & { readonly db: Database }`, uses `bun:sqlite` in WAL mode).
- `@kayjs/auth/oauth`: `github`, `discord`, `google`, `oauthProvider`.

## Configuration (`createAuth(options)`)

`createAuth()` returns a single object that is both the `KayPlugin` (register in `kay.config.ts`) and the app handle (import in routes/middleware):

- `store`: `AuthStore` (default `memoryAuthStore()`; a production start refuses it and `sqliteAuthStore()` on `:memory:`: use `sqliteAuthStore('./data/auth.sqlite')`).
- `secret`: string (defaults to `process.env.AUTH_SECRET`; required and ≥32 UTF-8 bytes in `NODE_ENV=production`).
- `site`: public origin (`https://example.com`, inherits `KayConfig.site`; required off localhost for mailed links & OAuth callbacks).
- `basePath`: route prefix (default `'/auth'`).
- `cookieName`: session cookie name (default `'kay_session'`).
- `sessionTtlSeconds` (default 30 days), `renewalIntervalSeconds` (sliding renewal), `tokenTtlSeconds` (default 15 min).
- `minPasswordLength`: default `12` (CNIL guidance). `defaultRole`: `'user'`. `defaultRedirect`: `'/'`.
- `requireEmailVerification`: default `true` (signup sends verification link and returns `202` without opening a session; signin refuses unverified users with `403`).
- `mailer`: pass a `@kayjs/mail` `Mailer` directly, or `sendMail(mail: AuthMailPayload)`.
- `providers`: `[github({ clientId, clientSecret, scopes? }), discord(...), google(...), oauthProvider(...)]`.
- `trustProxy`: inherits `KayConfig.trustProxy`. `trustedOrigins`: merged with `KayConfig.trustedOrigins`.
- `rateLimit`: `{ max?, windowMs? } | false` (default 15 a minute, per scope and address and per scope and email, counted in the server's store; a refusal is a `429` with `Retry-After`). `pruneIntervalMs`: default 15 min (`false` disables).
- RGPD minimization: `storeIp`: `'truncate'` (default, /24 IPv4 and /48 IPv6) | `true` | `false`; `storeUserAgent`: `true` (default) | `false`.
- `defaultUserFields`: extra columns/fields merged on user creation when extending `AuthUser`.

## Mounted Routes (default `basePath = '/auth'`) & `ctx.locals`

- `GET /auth/session` → `{ user, session }`
- `POST /auth/signup`, `POST /auth/signin`, `POST /auth/signout` (accept form or JSON; redirect or JSON based on `Accept`)
- `GET /auth/verify-email?token=...` and `GET /auth/magic-link/verify?token=...` (the mailed links) show a no-JS page whose button POSTs the token to the same URL; only that `POST` (form or JSON `{ token }`) consumes it, so mail scanners don't burn links
- `POST /auth/magic-link` mails the sign-in link; the first claim of an unverified account drops prior password, sessions, and OAuth links
- `GET /auth/oauth/:provider`, `GET /auth/oauth/:provider/callback`
- `ctx.locals.user` (`PublicUser | undefined`) and `ctx.locals.session` (`AuthSession | undefined`) — lazily resolved on first read. The session middleware has `scope: 'rendered'`: a prerendered page, built before any visitor, never resolves or renews a session, and stays on Bun's route table.

## Handle Methods (`auth`)

- `auth.guard({ redirectTo?, role?, allow? })`: returns a `Middleware` (HTML redirects to `redirectTo?next=...`, JSON gets `401`, wrong role/predicate gets `403`).
- `auth.getUser(ctx)`, `auth.getSession(ctx)`, `auth.resolve(ctx)`, `auth.createUser(input)`, `auth.createSessionForUser(userId, ctx)`, `auth.signOut(ctx)`, `auth.revokeAllSessions(userId)`, `auth.sendMagicLink(email, origin, redirectTo?)`, `auth.sendVerificationEmail(email, origin, redirectTo?)`.
- RGPD & maintenance: `auth.listSessions(userId)`, `auth.exportUser(userId)`, `auth.deleteUser(userId)`, `auth.pruneExpired()`, `auth.dispose()`.

## Snippets

```ts
// src/auth.ts
import { createAuth, github } from '@kayjs/auth'
import { sqliteAuthStore } from '@kayjs/auth/sqlite'
import { mail } from './mail'

export const auth = createAuth({
  store: sqliteAuthStore('./data/app.sqlite'),
  mailer: mail,
  providers: [github({ clientId: process.env.GITHUB_ID!, clientSecret: process.env.GITHUB_SECRET! })],
})
```

```ts
// src/routes/app/_middleware.ts
import { auth } from '../../auth'

export default auth.guard({ redirectTo: '/login' })
```
